quests.prepTerm: Through-check, Interline Agreement, Transit Concourse, Expedited Security
quests.protocolRule: Always confirm whether bags are checked to final destination or require customs retrieval at transit hub.
quests.travelerPrompt: My connection in Frankfurt departs in 45 minutes from Concourse B. Can my bags be checked straight through to Berlin?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Certainly! I have checked your luggage straight through to Berlin Brandenburg. Here are both boarding passes. Please proceed directly to Concourse B Gate 14 via the expedited transit lane.
quests.keyTakeaway: Verifying baggage destination tags and boarding deadlines prevents missed flights and misplaced luggage.

quests.prepTerm: Biosecurity, Sanitary Certificate, Quarantine, Non-declarable vs Declarable
quests.protocolRule: All agricultural products, seeds, and fresh meats must be formally declared to avoid severe customs fines.
quests.travelerPrompt: I am traveling with vacuum-packed cured ham and artisanal cheeses gifted by family. Do I need to declare these at customs?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Yes, all cured meats and dairy products must be declared on your customs declaration card upon arrival. The biosecurity inspector will examine them to ensure they comply with import regulations.
quests.keyTakeaway: Full transparency on customs declarations prevents heavy fines and biosecurity confiscation.

quests.concept: Layover Exits, Shore Passes & Passport Validity
quests.prepTerm: Shore Pass, Bilateral Waiver, Transit Zone, 6-Month Expiration Rule
quests.protocolRule: Passports must hold minimum 6 months validity; layover shore passes require confirmed onward boarding passes within 72 hours.
quests.travelerPrompt: We have an 8-hour layover in Tokyo Narita before our Sydney flight. Can we exit the airport to visit the town without a pre-arranged visa?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Passengers holding eligible passports may request a temporary Shore Pass at Japanese immigration, provided your onward ticket departs within 72 hours and your passport has at least six months of validity.
quests.keyTakeaway: Shore passes allow short excursion access during international layovers under strict onward ticket validation.

quests.prepTerm: Guaranteed Late Arrival, Night Audit, Reservation Hold, Incidental Deposit
quests.protocolRule: Reservations secured by credit card remain held through the night audit, but front desk notification ensures room assignment priority.
quests.travelerPrompt: Our flight was severely delayed and we will not reach the hotel until 2:30 AM. Will our room still be available?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Yes, your reservation is guaranteed by credit card and will remain active through the night audit. I will also flag your arrival time with the night manager so your keycards are pre-encoded.
quests.keyTakeaway: Confirming guaranteed hold status and notifying the night auditor prevents automated reservation cancellations.

quests.prepTerm: Property Irregularity Report (PIR), WorldTracer, Claim Tag, Courier Delivery
quests.protocolRule: Lodge a PIR immediately in the baggage arrivals hall before passing through customs exit doors.
quests.travelerPrompt: Our baggage carousel has cleared and my checked suitcase never arrived. What do I need to do to track it down?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: I am terribly sorry for the delay. Let us create a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) right away using your bag claim tag #BA-9021. We will track it on WorldTracer and courier it directly to your hotel upon arrival.
quests.keyTakeaway: The PIR reference number is the mandatory legal identifier for baggage compensation and worldwide courier delivery.

quests.concept: High-Speed Rail Supplements & Mandatory Seat Reservations

quests.protocolRule: International rail passes cover base fare but require mandatory seat supplements on high-speed rail lines (TGV, ICE, Frecciarossa).
quests.travelerPrompt: Does our Eurail Global Pass allow us to hop directly onto the high-speed TGV train to Marseille?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Your pass covers the rail distance, but the high-speed TGV requires a compulsory seat reservation before boarding. I can issue your seat supplement at Counter 3 right now so you avoid conductor fines.
quests.keyTakeaway: High-speed European trains strictly enforce mandatory seat reservations alongside open rail passes.

quests.concept: Duty of Care, Rebooking & Care Vouchers
quests.prepTerm: Duty of Care, Airline Rebooking, Meal Voucher, Accommodation Transfer
quests.protocolRule: Airline duty of care mandates complimentary refreshments, accommodation, and rebooking during technical delays exceeding 3 hours.
quests.travelerPrompt: Our flight to Chicago was cancelled due to mechanical failure. What assistance does the airline provide while we wait for tomorrow's flight?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Under our carrier duty of care, we have rebooked you on tomorrow morning's first flight. We are providing complimentary overnight hotel accommodation, shuttle transfers, and meal vouchers for dinner and breakfast.
quests.keyTakeaway: Duty of care packages must include confirmed rebooking, hotel stay, ground transfers, and sustenance vouchers.

quests.prepTerm: International Driving Permit (IDP), Primary Driver License, Security Pre-Auth, CDW Coverage
quests.protocolRule: An IDP is a legal translation document and is strictly invalid without presenting the original national physical license.
quests.travelerPrompt: I reserved a rental car online. I have my International Driving Permit with me, but I forgot my domestic license at home. Can I still pick up the car?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Unfortunately, an International Driving Permit is only valid as an official translation alongside your original national physical license. Road traffic regulations require us to inspect your primary physical license before releasing the keys.
quests.keyTakeaway: Never travel with only an IDP; the original national driver's license must always accompany it.

quests.prepTerm: Liquids Aerosols Gels (LAGs), 100ml / 3.4oz limit, Tamper-Evident Bag (STEB), Screen Checkpoint
quests.protocolRule: Liquids over 100ml in hand luggage are prohibited unless sealed in official duty-free STEB bags with receipt visible.
quests.travelerPrompt: Can I take this unopened bottle of olive oil through the security screening checkpoint in my backpack?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Under international security regulations, carry-on liquids are restricted to containers of 100ml (3.4 oz) or less in a clear quart-sized bag. Containers exceeding 100ml must be packed securely in your checked baggage.
quests.keyTakeaway: All liquids exceeding 100ml must be stowed in checked baggage unless packaged in certified STEB transit bags.

quests.concept: International Certificate of Vaccination (Yellow Card) & Incubation
quests.prepTerm: Yellow Fever Certificate, ICVP, Endemic Zone, 10-Day Incubation Validity
quests.protocolRule: Yellow fever vaccine certificates become legally valid 10 days after administration and are mandatory for entry from endemic zones.
quests.travelerPrompt: Our tour arrives from a designated yellow fever endemic region. When does our vaccination certificate become legally valid for entry?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: According to WHO and international health regulations, your International Certificate of Vaccination becomes legally valid for border entry 10 days following vaccination. Please present your original Yellow Card at health control.
quests.keyTakeaway: Yellow card health certificates require a 10-day post-inoculation waiting period to be recognized at border quarantine.

quests.concept: Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) & Local ATM Protocol
quests.prepTerm: Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC), Mark-up Spread, Local Denomination, Interbank Rate
quests.protocolRule: Always decline Dynamic Currency Conversion at foreign ATMs or card terminals; billing in local currency uses interbank rates.
quests.travelerPrompt: The ATM in the arrival terminal asks whether I want to be billed in my home currency or local euros. Which should I pick?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Always choose to be billed in the local currency (euros). Selecting your home currency triggers Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC), which adds hefty conversion mark-ups of 5% to 10% on your transaction.
quests.keyTakeaway: Opting for local currency billing bypasses predator DCC conversion rates and uses true interbank exchange rates.

quests.concept: International Motor Insurance Green Cards & Port Customs
quests.prepTerm: Green Card, Logbook / V5C, Headlight Beam Deflectors, Port Border Inspection
quests.protocolRule: Cross-channel and maritime vehicle transit requires vehicle ownership papers, nationality plates, and international insurance verification.
quests.travelerPrompt: We are boarding the vehicle ferry to cross the international channel. What documents must the driver show at port security?
quests.optimalDeskResponse: Port border authorities will inspect the physical passports for all occupants, your vehicle registration booklet (logbook), and your valid international motor insurance Green Card or territorial coverage proof.
quests.keyTakeaway: Maritime vehicle crossings require passport checks for all passengers combined with vehicle registration and proof of cross-border insurance.
